title: rosa blanda f. alba
intro: Rosa blanda f. alba, commonly known as the Fragrant White Rose, is a plant species within the family Rosaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, and its flowers and leaves are used to make teas, infusions, and other herbal remedies. The health benefits of Rosa blanda f. alba include its potential to reduce stress and anxiety, promote relaxation, and exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which may help to regulate the nervous system, improve mood, and boost the immune system.
